// diagnostic

E1262

Service `{name}` has a field jetpack doesn't recognize: `{field}`.

What

Service `{name}` has a field jetpack doesn't recognize: `{field}`.

Why

A dev-supervised `Service` stays the one ratified open record (U12) at parse time, but jetpack's dev-runtime tier is the only consumer of a dev service's fields — unlike the jetos `system.*.services` capture, nothing downstream forwards unread metadata, so an unrecognized key here is almost always a typo.

Fix

rename `{field}` to one of the recognized keys (`enable`, `ports`, `run`, `shutdown`, `data_dir`, `ready`, `after`, `before_start`, `sockets`, `restart`, `watch`), or remove it.
